summary: The BigQuery Engineer develops, manages, and optimizes Google BigQuery data warehouses and pipelines for large-scale analytics.
responsibilities: Build and maintain BigQuery datasets and ETL/ELT pipelines
Optimize query performance and storage costs
Implement data governance, security, and lineage
Integrate BigQuery with BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Data Studio
Collaborate with analytics and data science teams

education: 3–6 years of experience with BigQuery and cloud data engineering

skills_required.name: Expert in Google BigQuery and SQL
Experience with Python or ETL/ELT tools
Knowledge of cloud architecture and data pipelines
